builder: FedoraLinux-44 WSL2, nested KVM, 22 cores, podman 5.8.4, image-builder 76.0.0, QEMU 10.2.2
worktree: /root/bunny-os (ext4, clean checkout; never /mnt/c, where line-ending normalisation reports ~910 spurious modified files)
statement: Every row below was produced by running the named command and recording what it returned. Rows that have not been run are absent rather than assumed, so the gate reports them as missing. No row claims physical hardware or a production key, because neither exists.

source_integrity.method: Clean git checkout verified on the ext4 worktree before building
source_integrity.detail: Zero dirty entries at the build commit.

unit_tests.method: Full repository test suite on two platforms and two interpreters
unit_tests.detail: Passing on Windows 11 with Python 3.14.6 and on Fedora 44 with Python 3.14.3, plus the separately rooted installer suite.

documentation.method: Document, demonstration, and schema presence audit
documentation.detail: 47 documents, 18 demonstrations, and 11 schemas present. Release-specific notes are not included and remain a production requirement.

integration_tests.method: QEMU/KVM boot of two independently built images with serial-marker capture
integration_tests.detail: Both the developer and beta images reached a boot target and completed the Bunny OS boot health check under nested KVM.
